description.value: Failure the creature can't Cast a Spell or use abilities requiring concentration; it can attempt a new Will save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. Critical Failure as failure, and it is also slowed 1 (the slow does not end early).

cinderfall.incomplete: Failure: target can't Cast a Spell or use concentrate abilities (re-save each turn); crit failure adds slowed 1. The slowed-1 half alone would be buildable via a standard condition link, but the primary effect -- forbidding Cast a Spell/concentrate actions until a re-save -- has no standard PF2e condition item to link via @UUID the way slow.json/stupefy.json do, and no companion effect exists yet to encode a save-gated action-block. A card would need a bespoke `Effect: Denial of Service` companion; no clean predicate exists in pf2e-source to outright forbid `action:cast-a-spell` from a rule element.
